title: Replication Across Languages: Weak-to-Strong Generalization with a Multilingual Strong Model

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Relevant to multilingual deployment, but the chain from language barrier in oversight to specific safety harm is less direct. Interesting but not among the most pressing safety questions.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires multilingual models and non-English evaluation datasets. Finding appropriate multilingual test sets and ensuring evaluation quality across languages adds complexity. Moderate difficulty.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single experiment comparing English-only overseer on multilingual student. But requires sourcing non-English evaluation data and validating cross-lingual results. Somewhat diffuse for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
